name: matp
description: Sistema de Gestión y Digitalización de Colecciones Museográficas del MATP (PUCP) - monorepo

scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:ai && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: node scripts/py.mjs apps/api -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs apps/api -m ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:ai: node scripts/py.mjs services/ai -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs services/ai -m ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:web: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs apps/api -m ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs services/ai -m ruff format .
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ai && npm run test:web
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.seed
